identical_data_arm.consequence: Remains blocked. Relaxing the strictness class (8 files) would admit at most Cr50/52/53/54, Fe57, Mn55, W180, W183 -> 32/36 parents; Ni62, W182, W184, W186 are genuine source defects that no lawful parser change admits without an unrecorded scientific modification of the data. The arm needs either upstream correction of those four evaluations or a documented, protocol-governed source-normalization pass.
identical_data_arm.relaxation_note: The strictness class is a deliberate ACTINV contract (conservation anchored to an independent total). A lawful relaxation — e.g., extending the MT18 self-comparator amendment to non-fission MTs — is a separate phase decision with its own protocol; nothing in this classification compels it.
